svg.title: DSF504 Dashboard Enhancement Roadmap — 9 prompts across 3 layers
svg.desc: Three-layer diagram showing Data, Learning, and Governance enhancement prompts for the DSF504 ML teaching dashboard
svg.text: 9 self-contained implementation prompts across 3 teaching layers

g.text: P1
Data Profiling Studio
Add a "📈 Data Profiling" page to dashboard/app.py. For each column: histogram + KDE overlay, box-and-whisker
with outlier dots, skewness/kurtosis/entropy badges, % missing bar. Add pairwise scatter matrix (top-10 numeric
by variance) and a dataset health scorecard (completeness %, duplicate %, type-consistency %, cardinality flags).
P2
Data Cleansing Workshop
Add a "🧹 Data Cleansing" page. For each column with issues: show before/after distribution toggle, imputation
strategy dropdown (mean/median/mode/KNN/flag-and-drop), outlier method selector (IQR/Z-score/IF). Show a
live data-quality diff table. Concept cards explain MCAR/MAR/MNAR and leakage risk. Export cleaned parquet.
P3
Feature Engineering Studio+ (extend existing page)
Add to the existing FE page: a VIF table (flag VIF > 5), interaction-term builder (select 2 cols → add product/ratio
feature), encoding comparison panel (OHE vs frequency vs target encoding side-by-side macro-F1), and a feature
selection leaderboard (forward/backward selection with metric delta per step shown as a waterfall chart).
P4
Cross-Validation Explorer
Add a "🔁 Cross-Validation" page. Render fold strips (Plotly heatmap, rows=folds, cols=samples, colour=train/val).
Plot per-fold metric boxplot. Plot learning curves (score vs training size) from saved CV results. Show bias-variance
decomposition and an overfitting flag when train–val gap > 0.05. Load data from model_comparison.csv.
P5
Model Selection Workbench (extend Model Performance page)
Add tabs: sortable metrics table with conditional formatting, radar chart (all models × all metrics), combined ROC +
PR + DET curves on one canvas, calibration curves per model, McNemar's test p-value matrix for pairwise significance.
Add "Why this algorithm?" collapsible cards: complexity table, inductive bias, when to use / not use.
P6
Hyperparameter Explorer
Add a "🎛️ Hyperparameter Explorer" page. Load lgbm_optuna_trials.csv. Render: parallel coordinates (Plotly),
2-param contour heatmap (select x/y from dropdowns), fANOVA importance bar chart, convergence curve (trial #
vs best score). Slider panel replays any trial config and scores it on val set without retraining.
P7
Ethical AI & Fairness Checks
Add a "⚖️ Fairness" page. Protected-attribute selector from val_fe.parquet columns. Compute and display:
demographic parity ratio, equalised odds (TPR/FPR per group), calibration curves per group, disparate impact.
Flag EU AI Act risk tier. Surface mitigation options: threshold shift per group, reweighting, fairness-aware retraining.
P8
Teaching Mode & Concept Cards

Sidebar toggle "Teaching Mode". When ON: every Plotly chart gains an ℹ️ expander with concept card (plain explanation + citation + what-to-look-for). Guided walkthrough sequences cards into a lesson with progress tracker.

svg.text: One-click model card export (PDF + docx + JSON). Sections: dataset, preprocessing, CV results, champion spec, fairness audit, SHAP top-10, business impact. EU AI Act Annex IV template.
